recent.text: The latest on Rasmus Sandin and his timeline as he upgrades to contact, more on Vincent Desharnais, who could potentially return tomorrow, line combos with Anthony Beauvillier out and more in today’s Capitals Notebook. Every day @TheStandardDC: https://t.co/l8ituIRbdU

recent.text: Re: Rasmus Sandin: Spencer Carbery said that there’s no timeline for Sandin as he works back toward getting into game action. Wouldn’t rule out a potential conditioning loan, though that’s a management & Sandin decision and perhaps not as likely given how experienced he is.

recent.text: Caps injury updates from Carbery: Desharnais (appendix) now considered day-to-day, looks "solid" in practice. Sandin (ACL) still has a ways to go after taking contact for the first time this morning. Beauvillier (personal) should be good to go tomorrow.

recent.text: Spencer Carbery says he expects Anthony Beauvillier to be good to go tomorrow vs. Flyers after missing practice for personal reasons today.

recent.author: RMNB

recent.author: RMNB
